No sentence pools the news and notice families into a general claim about LLM-processed content; with two families each at alpha = .05, the chance that at least one rejects when both global nulls hold is up to 1 - 0.95^2 = 9.75% under independence (confirmation-A1 decision 9).

The frozen W_Bai code is unchanged; the specified W2_D arm uses Bai's stated vocabulary sizes instead.
